title: Montelibero Association
description: Landing page of the Montelibero Association.

hero.title: Montelibero Association
hero.description: An organization created to coordinate actions towards achieving the goals of the Montelibero movement, while preserving the freedom of participants and not claiming sole representation of the Movement's interests.

items.title: Assembly
items.description: The highest governing body of the Association, making decisions based on liquid democracy. The Assembly clarifies goals, approves strategic plans, and addresses key issues within the Association's framework.

items.title: Council
items.description: The executive body ensuring implementation of the Assembly's decisions. The Council handles budgeting, accounting, blockchain multi-signature, and serves as the default guarantor and arbitrator in the Montelibero legal system.

items.title: MTL Court
items.description: An arbitration court. An institution created to provide an optimal mechanism for resolving disputes between participants and supporters of the movement.

items.title: Distributed Management
items.description: A coordination platform for activists and experts, occupying the place of an "extended government" in the Montelibero Association. Designed to ensure optimal configuration of coordinated management of common tasks.

items.title: Mission Control Center
items.description: A coordination platform for MTLA officials and coordinators of key projects, programs, and areas of activity.

items.title: Working Groups
items.description: Bodies for preliminary elaboration of issues submitted to the Council. They perform the role of "parliamentary committees".

items.title: Agreement
items.description: The founding document defining the structure, goals, and operating principles of the Montelibero Association.

items.title: Participation Regulations
items.description: Specifies and regulates the norms of the Agreement regarding admission, exclusion, and changes in the status of participants.

items.title: Principles of Montelibero Association
items.description: Basic principles that serve as a guideline for decision-making within the Association and describing our activities.

items.title: Council Regulations
items.description: Rules governing the Council's work and decision-making procedures.
